selected_inputs: the target sections 3-13 (registers, tools, frozen tables)
the D26 component and issue registers, the runbook

args: for f in tests/closure/*.mjs tests/manifest/gate.mjs; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && sh -n tests/closure/rust-build-census.sh && for j in tests/closure/registers/*.json tests/closure/language-manifest-v1.json tests/closure/language-corpus-v1.json tests/envmap/facts/D27.json tests/manifest/components.json tests/manifest/issues.json tests/reprove/runbook.json tests/hygiene/status-classification.json; do node -e 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1]))' $j || exit 1; done && ! grep -nE "'(FACT|EV|ENV|IMPL|PROBE)-[A-Z0-9]" tests/closure/*.mjs && node -e 'const J=p=>JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(p));const I=J("tests/manifest/issues.json").issues;const by=Object.fromEntries(I.map(i=>[i.id,i]));if(I.length!==41||!by["I-38"]||by["I-38"].class!=="B"||!by["I-39"]||by["I-39"].class!=="D"||!by["I-40"]||by["I-40"].class!=="A"||!/^REPAIRED/.test(by["I-40"].status))process.exit(1);const C=J("tests/manifest/components.json").components;if(C.length!==72||!C.some(c=>c.id==="TEST-CLOSURE")||!C.some(c=>c.id==="RECORD-FOUNDATION-CLOSURE"))process.exit(1);const Rb=J("tests/reprove/runbook.json");if(!Rb.groups.closure||Object.keys(Rb.facts).length!==123)process.exit(1);const F=J("tests/envmap/facts/D27.json");if(F.facts.length!==8||F.probes.length!==6)process.exit(1);const M=J("tests/closure/language-manifest-v1.json");if(M.language_version!==1||M.statement_keywords.length!==31)process.exit(1);const Cp=J("tests/closure/language-corpus-v1.json");if(Cp.language_version!==1||Cp.rows.length!==53)process.exit(1);console.log("issues",I.length,"components",C.length,"runbook facts",Object.keys(Rb.facts).length,"facts",F.facts.length,"keywords",M.statement_keywords.length,"corpus rows",Cp.rows.length)' && echo 'syntax, JSON, no fact/evidence/node name in the tools; registers as intended'

T=$(mktemp -d) && node tests/closure/structural-check.mjs --registers tests/closure/registers --components tests/manifest/components.json --graph design/environment-map/graph.json --facts-spec tests/envmap/facts/D27.json --root . --render $T/registers.md --out $T/structural-check.json && node -e 'const s=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1]));console.log(JSON.stringify(s.counts));if(s.status!=="PASS"||s.counts.blockers!==30||s.counts.acceptance_steps!==16||s.counts.sequence!==8||s.counts.hardening!==16)process.exit(1)' $T/structural-check.json
